DATASET: IO-VNBD processed windows: data/processed/{train,validation,test}/<seq>_windows.npz, indexed by data/processed/manifest.csv
TARGET_SOURCE: reference vehicle speed (Velocity km/hr / 3.6) at window end, nowcast horizon=0
SPLIT_METHOD: sequence-wise (whole drives) from manifest['split']; drive sub-segments grouped; built by scripts/prepare_dataset.py with split_seed=26168
PREPROCESSING: src/data pipeline only (canonical schema, ENU reference, gap-aware windowing). Windows loaded raw from npz.
NORMALIZATION: NONE (raw sensor units fed to the summary-stat extractor)
BASELINE_MODEL: Baseline 0 = mean(y_train); Step 12A model = RandomForestRegressor on 9-stat-per-channel window summary features (108 features)

TABULAR_REPRESENTATION.flat_order: row-major: all channels for stat[0], then stat[1], ...

TEST_POLICY: test split touched exactly once, after model freeze
